title: What If You Stood on Saturn's Death Star Moon, Mimas?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Mimas? One crater nearly shattered this entire moon.
Mimas is only about 400 kilometers across, small enough to cross a country.
Its Herschel crater is about 139 kilometers wide, almost one third of the moon itself.
The crater walls rise roughly 5 kilometers, and parts of the floor drop 10 to 12 kilometers.
In the middle, a peak climbs 6 to 8 kilometers, about as tall as Everest.
The impact nearly tore Mimas apart. Astronomers are still surprised it survived in one piece.
